'''''Advertisement''''' was a [[Painting/Legends|portrait]] made during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It depicted a [[Pa'lowick/Legends|Pa'lowick]] posing in a V-string bathing suit and featured [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] writing.

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Advertisement'' can be obtained via the rare loot system. The advertisement in question dated back to an early version of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba's]] Themepark, but it is no longer available as of 2004. The picture came in either a normal or ornate frames of gold or silver color.
